decision_rule: Pass only when the image is recognizable at browse-card scale, materially distinguishes the entry from its common confusions, and does not overclaim a unique canonical motif for broad terms.
verification_boundary: A structural-review pass advances an image to reviewed, not verified. Source/content verification and final browser QA remain separate gates.
